BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION


IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION                     )
OF EL PASO ELECTRIC COMPANY FOR                      )
REVISION OF ITS RETAIL ELECTRIC                      )     Case No. 25-00082-UT
RATES PURSUANT TO ADVICE NOTICE                      )
NO. 317                                              )




   EPE’S VERIFIED RESPONSE TO THE BENCH REQUEST ORDER REGARDING
                RULE 440 REPORTS ISSUED NOVEMBER 6, 2026

       El Paso Electric Company (“EPE”) hereby files this response to the Bench Requests in

Ordering Paragraph A of the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission’s (“NMPRC” or

“Commission”) November 6, 2026, Bench Request Order Regarding Rule 440 Reports (“Bench

Request”). This response and Exhibits 1 and 2 hereto is supported by the Declaration of Omar A.

Gallegos, Vice President – System Planning and Construction, which is attached as Exhibit 3.

                                           RESPONSE

Question 6(a):

        “Pursuant to EPE Witness George Novela’s Supplemental Testimony, Exhibit GN-1S,

filed on May 7, 2026, EPE should verify whether the columns labeled “440 Estimated Amounts”

and the “Actual Amount included in Application” are both for the total of EPE’s company costs,

or for the New Mexico jurisdictional costs.

               (i) If there is a different methodology for calculating the estimated and actual costs,

       EPE should describe the different methodologies and correct and re-file Exhibit GN-1S to

       clearly show the total company costs and to show the total New Mexico allocated costs.

EPE’s Response:

       EPE has not presented a different methodology for calculating the estimated and actual


                                                 1
 costs. Both columns contain Total Company costs as consistent with Rule 440 reports. EPE has

corrected the label on Columns G, H, and I to eliminate any confusion. The corrected exhibit is

attached to this Bench Request Response as Exhibit 1. Changes are shown in red.



Question 6(b):

       Pursuant to George Novela’s Supplemental Testimony, Exhibit GN-1S, Report Nos. 75

and 89 both include Project Number DN164. Project DN164 is named “MOONGATE (LE1)

GETAWAY & FEEDERS” in CSP-1 from EPE Witness Cynthia Prieto’s Direct Testimony and

“NEW 24KV AND 25KV LINE (MOO 23 - APO 20) FROM MOONGATE SUBSTATION

TO APOLLO SUBSTATION PROJECT” in Exhibit GN-1S. EPE should explain if including

DN164 in both 440 Report Nos. 75 and 89 is an error.

EPE’s Response:

       Including DN164 in both Rule 440 Report Nos. 75 and 89 was not an error. DN164 is a

multi-phase feeder extension project, part of which was included in 440 Report No. 75. Funding

project numbers TL119 and DN164 included in 440 Report No. 75 contain workorders totaling

$16,937,995. DN164 workorders were also included in 440 Report No. 89 for a separate

distribution backfeed connection undertaking between MOO 23 and APO 20. However, no

costs related to that separate undertaking are included in the Amended Filing but are expected

to be included in a future filing once they are in-service. Exhibit GN-01S Amended Filing has

been updated to reflect this narrative and is attached as Exhibit 1 to this Bench Request

Response.




                                                2
 Question 6(c):

       Pursuant to George Novela’s Supplemental Testimony, Exhibit GN-1S, there are eight

Rule 440 Reports (Report Nos. 77, 83, 88, 101, 103, 110, 111, 114) for which the difference

between the estimated and actual costs exceed 20 percent. EPE identified these Reports in its

original Application but did not include them in its Amended Application. EPE should attach

the updated Reports to its Response to this Bench Request.

EPE’s Response:

        The Rule 440 Reports listed in this Bench Request were originally filed as indicated in

Column F of Exhibit 1. Those Reports were not included in EPE’s Original Filing. As the

Bench Request indicates, information on the Rule 440 Reports was included as supplemental

testimony in Exhibit GN-1S. The supplemental testimony and Exhibit GN-1S were refiled as

part of EPE’s Amended Application.

       EPE understands Bench Request Question 6(c) to instruct EPE to attached updated Rule

440 Reports because each of the eight identified Reports varied from the estimated costs by +/-

20 percent. As reflected in Exhibit GN-1S Amended Filing, an amended Rule 440 Report was

not required for each of the eight Reports identified in the Bench Request for the reasons

discussed below.

       The following updates have been made from Exhibit GN-1S Amended Filing and are

provided as Exhibit 1 to this Bench Request Response (shown in red).

       1. A new column was added to provide the project status as of the Amended Filing test

          year period.

          The project status descriptions are as follows:

           a. Completed – workorders included in the 440 Project Scope that qualify as used


                                                3
    and useful have been placed in-service. Costs closed to plant in service at the end

   of the Amended Filing test year period are included in column H.

       i. Report No. 103 is included in this category.

b. Completed – Network Upgrade Repayment in Progress – projects related to

   Large Generator Interconnection Agreements (LGIA) that have met their COD

   requirements. Repayment of the network upgrade costs, as listed in the LGIA,

   have started but are not completed as of the end of the Amended Filing test year

   period. Costs closed to plant in service at the end of the Amended Filing test year

   period are included in column H. Additional network upgrade repayment costs

   will be included in future New Mexico rate case applications.

       i. Report Nos. 77 and 114 are included in this category.

c. Multi-Phase partial completion – this is a multi-phase 440 project scope with

   many workorders under one or more funding projects. Workorders included in

   the 440 Project Scope that qualify as used and useful have been placed in-service

   and the costs closed to plant in service as of the end of the Amended Filing test

   year period are included in column H. Additional workorders which have not met

   used and useful criteria will be included in future New Mexico base rate case

   applications.

       i. Report Nos. 83, 88, and 101 are included in this category.

d. Not Completed – no workorders have met used and useful criteria or have been

   placed in-service within the Amended Filing test year period. These workorders

   will be included in future New Mexico base rate case applications.

       i. Report Nos. 110 and 111 are included in this category.


                                     4
 Each of the eight Rule 440 Reports is addressed below:

1. Report No. 77 Actual Amount included in Application column H is the amount

   closed to plant in service in the Amended Filing test year period. Project status:

   Completed – Network Upgrade Repayment in Progress.

2. Report No. 83 Actual Amount included in Application column H is the amount

   closed to plant in service in the Amended Filing test year period. Project status:

   Multi-Phase, Partial Completion.

3. Report No. 88 Actual Amount included in Application column H is the amount

   closed to plant in service in the Amended Filing test year period. Project status:

   Multi-Phase, Partial Completion.

4. Report No. 101 Actual Amount included in Application column H is the amount

   closed to plant in service in the Amended Filing test year period. Project status:

   Multi-Phase, Partial Completion.

5. Report No. 103 Actual Amount included in Application column H is the amount

   closed to plant in service in the Amended Filing test year period. Project status:

   Completed. This emergency filing was a high-level budget estimate and contained

   the following in the Undertaking Purpose/Justification portion of the report, “While

   the total project cost is estimated to be $1.2 million, EPE’s share of that cost is

   approximately 40 percent or $480,000.” The variance between the $480,000 and

   $537,802 is approximately 12 percent, therefore a Rule 440 Report Amendment was

   not filed.

6. Report No. 110 Actual Amount included in Application column H has been updated


                                       5
            to zero in the amended exhibit. Project status: Not Completed - No Costs included

           in Amended Filing.

       7. Report No. 111 Actual Amount included in Application column H has been updated

           to zero in the amended exhibit. Project status: Not Completed - No Costs included

           in Amended Filing.

       8. Report No. 114 Actual Amount included in Application column H is the amount

           closed to plant in service in the Amended Filing test year period. Project status:

           Completed – Network Upgrade Repayment in Progress.



Question 6(d):

       The Amended Rule 440 Reports included in EPE’s Amended Application contain errors

and omissions. Specifically, the form labeled “NMPRC Rule 17.5.440 Form” was correctly filed

for Report No. 70. However, for Report Nos. 72, 75, 91, 92, 94, 97, 98, 99, 104, the relevant

form appears to be a repeat of Report No. 70. EPE should correct this error and attach the

corrected Amended Rule 440 Reports, including any that were omitted in EPE’s Amended

Application, to its Response to this Bench Request.

EPE’s Response:

       The corrected Amended Rule 440 package is provided as Exhibit 2 to this Bench

Request. The error noted in the Bench Request, that the Amendments to Rule 440 Report Nos.

72, 75, 91, 92, 94, 97, 98, 99, 104 were duplicates of the Amendment to Rule 440 Report No.

70 is due to a conversion error that occurred when the original filed Amended Rule 440 Reports

were downloaded from PRCe360. EPE has not identified any Amended Rule 440 Reports that

were omitted in EPE’s Amended Application.


                                               6
 Question 6 (e):

       If EPE finds any other errors, omissions, or discrepancies the Hearing Examiners have

not yet identified in EPE’s Amended Rule 440 Reports, EPE should identify and describe such

errors, omissions, or discrepancies, and attach the corrected Report(s), Notices, or Testimonies

to its Response to this Bench Request.

EPE’s Response:

       Other than the version issue addressed in Response to 6.d, EPE has not identified any

errors, omissions, or discrepancies from the filed Amended Rule 440 Reports.

       However, as indicated in EPE’s responses to Questions 6(a)(i) and 6(c) above, Exhibit 1

reflects other changes from Exhibit GN-1S Amended Filing (shown in red). These changes do

not change the substance of the filed Rule 440 Reports, and no additional amended or updated

440 Reports are required as a result of these changes.

           General updates throughout Exhibit 1 include:

           a. Filing 74/76 – Project Number TL295 was listed twice on the same line.

               Removed duplicate.

           b. Filing 77 – Corrected project numbers listed in column D and updated the Actual

               Amount included in Application column H to reflect the workorders under the

               related Funding Projects TS156/TL294.

           c. Filing 89 – Updated Actual Amount included in Application column H to zero.

           d. Filing 110 – Corrected project numbers listed in column D and updated Actual

               Amount included in Application column H to zero.

           e. Filing 111 – Updated Actual Amount included in Application column H to zero.

           f. Filing 116 – Updated Actual Amount included in Application in column H.


                                                7
                                        CONCLUSION

       EPE appreciates the opportunity to provide these verified responses to the Bench Request

issued on November 6, 2026, in this docket.
